ms.promise: Pilot project with real users. Issuing a real Employment credential utilising our framework and system.
ms.criteria: Our system is capable of issuing employment credential with our proposed framework. A real employee in our platform will create a personal DID in ProofSpace App. Once the legal agreement on the job position has been reached both parties confirm this in our platform and Fairway issues Proof of Employment -Credential to the selected candidate. This user on our system receives an employment credential corresponding a real recruitment and a real job.
ms.report:
In the last 2 Months our team has been working on the the final deliverables of the project, implementing our proposed Employment Credential Framework and syncing Proofspace App from our platform so that the system is capable issuing employment credentials according to it. We finalized the technology and and tested it in use. 

For the piloting we partnered with a real business in Addis Ababa called Vulcan ICT that has recently started utilizing Fairway platform in their recruitment. We taught them to use Credential issuing on https://fairway.work/ platform and Proofspace App to view credentials for their employees. For the video demonstration we co-created a recruitment process pilot with employment credential issuing. 

Evidence: https://youtu.be/DNuW6Nr_NMY

ms.report:
Fairway platform now has the ability issue Poof of Employment credentials through Proofspace for recruited job seekers after the job agreement has been reached. The Employment credentials are issued following the Framework we proposed after studying the Ethiopian market and W3C standards .
This feature is available on our platform for job seekers who have been recruited.
